en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard or card-like ticket with an Art Nouveau–style design. On the left is a muscular, semi‑nude male figure with arms crossed, standing upright; behind his shoulder appears a small heraldic shield. On the right is a dense block of German text announcing a jubilee exhibition of craftsmen in Styria, held in Graz in 1908, including dates and sections of the exhibition. At the bottom is a printed serial number: "No 133916."
